description: This file defines the 'MacNodeRuntime' actor which manages various capabilities such as camera, location, system commands, browser proxy, and canvas operations on a macOS platform. It provides asynchronous methods to handle commands like screen recording, camera snapshot, location retrieval, executing system commands, and managing UI overlays. The code also includes logic for security, approval prompts, and event emission related to these operations.

classes.name: MacNodeRuntime
classes.description: A Swift actor managing system operations, UI overlays, device interactions, and security prompts on macOS, interfacing with various services and performing command handling.

methods.name: updateMainSessionKey
methods.description: Updates the main session key used for identifying the current operational context.

methods.name: setEventSender
methods.description: Sets the callback function for sending event messages asynchronously.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Main dispatch method that routes incoming command requests to specific handlers based on command type.

methods.name: isCanvasCommand
methods.description: Checks if a given command string is related to canvas operations.

methods.name: handleCanvasInvoke
methods.description: Processes canvas-related commands such as present, hide, navigate, evalJS, and snapshot.

methods.name: handleA2UIInvoke
methods.description: Handles A2UI (application-to-UI) push and reset commands.

methods.name: handleBrowserProxyInvoke
methods.description: Processes browser proxy requests, checking if browser control is enabled.

methods.name: handleCameraInvoke
methods.description: Manages camera operations including snap, clip, and list devices.

methods.name: handleLocationInvoke
methods.description: Retrieves the current geolocation, respecting permissions and accuracy settings.

methods.name: handleScreenRecordInvoke
methods.description: Handles screen recording operations and returns the recording as a base64-encoded string.

methods.name: mainActorServices
methods.description: Fetches and caches service interfaces that must run on the main actor context.

methods.name: handleA2UIReset
methods.description: Resets the A2UI interface by executing JavaScript in the canvas context.

methods.name: handleA2UIPush
methods.description: Pushes messages to the A2UI interface, encoding messages as JSONL or array.

methods.name: ensureA2UIHost
methods.description: Ensures the A2UI host page is loaded and reachable before messaging.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves and constructs the URL to the A2UI host page based on the gateway's canvas host URL.

methods.name: isA2UIReady
methods.description: Checks whether the A2UI interface is fully loaded and ready, with optional polling.

methods.name: handleSystemRun
methods.description: Executes arbitrary system commands securely, handling approval, environment, and security checks.

methods.name: handleSystemWhich
methods.description: Implements a 'which'-like command to locate executables in standard search paths.

methods.name: resolveSystemRunApproval
methods.description: Asynchronously handles user prompts and security policies for system command execution.

methods.name: handleSystemExecApprovalsGet
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of current execution approval configurations.

methods.name: handleSystemExecApprovalsSet
methods.description: Updates execution approval configuration files with provided data.

methods.name: emitExecEvent
methods.description: Emits an event related to command execution, optionally sending JSON payloads.

methods.name: validateScreenRecordingIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks permissions and emits events for screen recording if necessary.

methods.name: executeSystemRun
methods.description: Runs a system command and captures complete output, emitting lifecycle events.

methods.name: decodeParams
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into a specified Decodable type, with error handling.

methods.name: encodePayload
methods.description: Encodes an Encodable object into a JSON string.

methods.name: canvasEnabled
methods.description: Checks if canvas-related features are enabled via user defaults.

methods.name: cameraEnabled
methods.description: Checks if camera features are enabled via user defaults.

methods.name: locationMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current location permission mode setting.

methods.name: locationPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Determines if precise location is enabled.

methods.name: errorResponse
methods.description: Generates an error response with a specified code and message.

methods.name: encodeCanvasSnapshot
methods.description: Encodes an NSImage into PNG or JPEG format with optional resizing.

methods.name: scaleImage
methods.description: Scales an NSImage proportionally within a maximum width if specified.
